detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Get into the rhythm with the new Mystery Skulls Music Pack. Celebrate the thrilling finale of the Mystery Skulls Animated series!

Featuring FIVE new Rhythm Rifts by Mystery Skulls:

  • "Ghost"

  • "Freaking Out"

  • "Hellbent feat. Snowblood"

  • "The Future"

  • "When I'm With You"

Each Mystery Skulls Rhythm Rift features:

  • Paranormal enthusiast, Vivi Yukino

  • Background visualizer with custom particle FX

  • Four Difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard and Impossible

  • Remix Mode: Experience a fresh beatmap your way every playthrough while enjoying the original level's rhythmic design

  • Buying any song from this Music Pack also unlocks custom Mystery Skulls items to equip in your Rift Profile!

  • Songs are available in both original and explicit versions to play
